title: 目標達成の後に・あの回のように

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Even in her recent scrimmages, there's been a clear shift in Kawakami Princess's performance.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I've got this! Rrraaaagh!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huff… Huff… Trainer…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Th-thank you… But I'm still overexerting myself.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's true, she ran too hard in the early portion of the race. It didn't go how we planned, but…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Before, her body would've become stiff just thinking of the race, and her form would crumble as a result.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (But today, she paid close attention to keeping her movements under control. She's learned how to use her strength with intent and focus.)
choice_data_list: Your form is steadily improving, too.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh! Ehehe… Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (She's gotten sufficiently used to racing that she's no longer straining herself from the get-go. It might actually be time for…)
choice_data_list: I have something important to discuss.
I have something important to discuss.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Something important?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Simply delicious! Another portion, please, chef!

text_block_list.name: Ramen Chef
text_block_list.text: You've got gusto, missy. Here, have another serving of noodles!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: My trainer's picking up the bill today! So I'm planning to finish off at least five more servings after this!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Still, I must say, Trainer… When you said "important discussion," I never imagined we'd have it at a ramen shop… Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: This is just like in episode ten of Princess Fighter, when Legendary Trainer makes an important confession…
choice_data_list: Exactly. That's why I wanted to talk here.
Exactly. That's why I wanted to talk here.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh?
choice_data_list: I want you to enter the Japanese Oaks!
I want you to enter the Japanese Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Th-th-the Oaks?! The Japanese Oaks?! Are you serious?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Whoa, whoawhoawhoawhaa?! But the Japanese Oaks is a G1 race! And not just any G1 race, either—it's the peak of the once-in-a-lifetime Tiara tour!
choice_data_list: This is the kind of challenge you wanted to take on, isn't it?
This is the kind of challenge you wanted to take on, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: The Tiara is the princess's crown, obtainable only from the grandest of stages—the G1 races.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: And I always envisioned myself competing fiercely in the Tiara tour, awakening my potential on the field of battle just like Princess Fighter.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: From the very beginning, this has been what she's dreaming of.
choice_data_list: It's time to let your princess power bloom.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ehe… Ehehe. Thank you! ♪

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: …And that's what happened, King! Isn't my trainer amazing?!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Hmm. Well, I can say it was a rather thoughtful proposition. But aren't you attending a press conference today?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Press… conference?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: AAAAHHH!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: I t-t-t-totally forgot! And Trainer reminded me so many times!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Really?! Oh, you airhead! Hurry and get ready!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: I'll help you out, but don't expect me to do everything. Come now, run!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The press conference is due to start in one minute. I've tried contacting Kawakami Princess several times, but she hasn't answered…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Traineeeer! I'm so soooorry!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text: Wheeze… Wheeze… Did we make it in time?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Right! Let's charge straight in! Charge… charge?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ch-chaaaarge?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Crash!

text_block_list.name: Moderator
text_block_list.text: Th-the door… She broke it down with a single kick…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: D-did I make it?! It's me! Kawakami Princess!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Pfft… Hahaha! What an unpredictable Umamusume! Never in my entire life…

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Tell me about it. I wish I had gotten that on camera! Imagine the editor's response.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Really?! Then I can do it one more time!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Moderator
text_block_list.text: Okay, let's all regain our composure and begin the racer interviews. First up is…

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes. I would first like to express my thanks to you all for being here today. I've pursued the Tiara tour this far with the aim of winning the Japanese Oaks.

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Every bit of effort I've put into this will be displayed in my results. Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: Wow, there's the overwhelming favorite, so confident and dignified. It's no wonder she's the most popular contender in the Tiara tour.

text_block_list.name: Moderator
text_block_list.text: Next up, we have…

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Y-yes! Is it me?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh… No?! Okay, then, the next racer… please go ahead!

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Pfft…

text_block_list.name: Moderator
text_block_list.text: Finally, we'll be taking questions from the audience. Raise your hand if you have something to ask!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Okay!

text_block_list.name: Moderator
text_block_list.text: Y-yes, Kawakami Princess?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: You, with the yellow and pink striped ear accessory! Is your hair ornament based on Honey Lemon Princess from Sugar Love♪Princess Fighter?!

text_block_list.name: Dark-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: M-me?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes! You love Princess Fighter, right?! I'm a huge fan myself! That's all I wanted to ask!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
choice_data_list: Please move on to the next question.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Pfft… Ahahaha! You and your trainer make a unique combo! I'm sure you'll go on to gain many fans!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Huh? Really?! Th-thank you for saying so!

text_block_list.name: Chestnut-haired Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Hey, this is a press conference for racers entering the Japanese Oaks. Don't you think you should behave more appropriately?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: O-oh… right! My name's Kawakami Princess! My objective this year is to enter the Japanese Oaks and…

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Hahaha, we don't need a self-introduction at this point. Hehe, just relax and answer the questions.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's over… It's finally done…
choice_data_list: Let's work on staying calm for next time.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ughh, you're right… I suppose I'll need to train in that area too, won't I?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although she's gotten used to racing, it seems she still has a lot of room to grow mentally.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However, if she can learn to remain firm and composed, she'll improve her consistency in races too.

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text: Oh, Kawakami Princess! Do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text: Haha, I just wanted to give you some words of encouragement. My kids are huge fans of yours.

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text: They'll be watching you in the Japanese Oaks with their friends. So, um, please give it your all!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ohhhh! Leave it to me!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm going to place first at the Japanese Oaks! A princess must claim victory!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As if someone flipped a switch, Kawakami Princess goes from downhearted to full of energy. She still has a long way to go, but we make a vow to win the Japanese Oaks.
